page_title: Have all your reading in one place

sources.entry: ReadKit - Bookmark and RSS management client.

summary.name: ReadKit
summary.one_liner: ReadKit is a read-later and RSS client for iPhone, iPad and Mac that syncs with major RSS and bookmarking services.
use_cases: Save articles from Safari to read later
Read news feeds in one app across iPhone, iPad and Mac
Sync RSS subscriptions with a self-hosted or third-party feed service
Read articles offline with cached images
Subscribe to YouTube channels via RSS
Migrate feed subscriptions using OPML files
summary.what_it_does: ReadKit combines RSS reading and read-later saving in one app. It supports built-in iCloud RSS and Read Later sync, plus connections to services such as Feedbin, Feedly, Inoreader, FreshRSS, Miniflux, NewsBlur, The Old Reader, Tiny Tiny RSS, Fever, Instapaper, Wallabag and Pinboard. Features include smart folders, search by content/title/source, a built-in reader mode, offline reading with cached images, gesture-based mark-as-read, and OPML import/export. Essential features are free with no ads, and Premium unlocks extras such as multi-account support, unlimited feeds and AI article summaries.
notable: Syncs with many RSS and read-later services including Feedbin, Feedly, Inoreader, Instapaper and Wallabag
Built-in iCloud RSS and Read Later service
Premium AI article summaries require Apple Intelligence and iOS 26
Share extension saves articles from Safari and other apps
caveats: Premium features require a universal subscription or one-time lifetime purchase
Built-in RSS service is limited to 20 feeds unless upgraded to Premium
AI article summaries need ReadKit Premium, Apple Intelligence and iOS 26
